facts.quote: These procedures apply only to authenticated live station feeds in the active harbour.
pause the receiver and obtain a journal checkpoint before requesting the missing interval
Preserve the original observation identifiers during replay.
Resume the receiver only after the exporter acknowledges the checkpoint.
leave it paused until a fresh authenticated heartbeat arrives
Keep a journal file for at least seven days and until the corresponding export checksum is verified.
A legal hold blocks deletion regardless of age or checksum status.
These rules govern daily bundles consumed by harbour analysts.
Publish a bundle only when every included station has a verified daily checksum.
Include the observation timezone in the manifest.
A missing station must be listed explicitly as missing rather than represented by zero water levels.
A late observation creates a new bundle revision; never overwrite an already published bundle.
Keep the previous revision addressable for existing citations.
Exported bundles are derived products, not journal replacements until their checksums have been verified.
Keep a journal file for at least seven days and until the corresponding export checksum is verified.
Both conditions must hold before deletion.
